mapper.sql: id, content, status, priority, sort, is_published, discovered_time, completed_time, update_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, discovered_time, COALESCE(completed_time, NOW())) AS duration_minutes
mapper.select: SELECT FROM todo ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'), sort ASC, id DESC
SELECT FROM todo WHERE is_published = 1 ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE'), sort ASC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (content, status, priority, sort, is_published, discovered_time, completed_time, update_time) VALUES (#{content}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{sort}, #{published}, #{discoveredTime}, #{completedTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo SET is_published = #{published}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE todo SET sort = #{sort}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
